source_law.text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: A pedestrian shall not suddenly leave a curb or other place of safety and walk or run into the path of a vehicle which is so close that it is impossible for the driver to yield.

witness_branches: Leaving a curb into a vehicle path.

requirement_dispositions.branch: Leaving a curb into a vehicle path, conditional inability to yield, and introductory cross-reference applicability
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Both cases acquire original pedestrian and vehicle source traces and a conditional stopping range. Exact cross-reference texts are bound in statutory-crossrefs.json; original context review must resolve applicability. Numeric assumptions do not define statutory impossibility or actual driver capability.

neutral_baseline.description: Frozen cell and actor with target rule inactive or neutral; retained only as a proposal, not a selected recording.
